location_fine: village road, police office, and soccer field
visual_synopsis: A multi-segment episode: a man drives an old UAZ van through a village with an older passenger, then a police officer questions a disheveled man in an office, then a soccer team trains under a suited coach, two men in matching plaid shirts harvest grapes and talk near a lake, and it closes with a well-dressed older man and a young woman talking in an apartment stairwell.
